pages.title: Omnipotent Ingot
pages.text: Metal that is whatever metal it needs to be. Forged at the reborn Core, out of the boundless and the dust of the old Core.

Forged at the reborn Core's $(item)Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Singularity, Dodecaract Excavator, Equilibrium Lattice, Eschaton Cell, Eschaton Core, Euclidean Anchor, Greaves of the Absolute, Hand of the Demiurge and more.
